evals.name: separate-files
evals.prompt: Separate the author search state and filtering operations from its React screen.
evals.expected_output: Sibling model and view files in Features/Authors/Listing.
assertions: Creates an injectable AuthorSearchViewModel in its own .ts file.
Keeps the search term, setter and name filtering in the model.
Binds the .tsx view with withViewModel rather than constructing the class.

evals.name: live-results
evals.prompt: Connect the author search screen to the generated AllAuthors query while keeping its view model independent of React hooks.
evals.expected_output: The view passes live rows to the model.
assertions: Calls the hook in the view and checks the result before reading rows.
Filters authors.data in the model without a second query or hard-coded array.

evals.name: wire-router
evals.prompt: Show how a routed Arc React app mounts the bound AuthorSearch page.
evals.expected_output: Metadata and decorators are configured before mounting the providers.
assertions: Imports MVVM and BrowserRouter from their packages.
Places BrowserRouter inside MVVM and mounts both inside Arc.
